Billed in-story as holding the "ICW World Heavyweight Championship" -- matching this record's own existing RSPWF Top 200 poll tag of ICW for 1998 exactly -- "The Italian Stallion" Tony Paseno wins his tournament opener and quarterfinal (over Fang, then CandyMan), fights James Pillow to a double count-out, and loses a billed Americas Championship tournament match to Randy Acorn, then loses again -- to a screwjob -- interfering in James Miller's Americas Championship win, across Monday Night Elite (12, 19, 26 October and 16 November 1998); this run predates this record's own existing June 1999 tenure.
